Messages.Author: Uriel
Messages.Body:
Here we go:
1) Can permanents be transferred/stolen by minions who do not meet the
clan requirement? (e.g. If Anton has the Femur and is diablerized by a
brujah, can the Brujah take and use the equipment?)
2) Locuipment counts also as equipment while in play?
3) Can minions attempt action, that cost more blood than they have?
4) Can a minion use Shadow Strike, if an Immortal Grapple has been
played.
5) If an action is directed at the owner of the minion who attempts
it,
a) can both her prey and predator block?
b) is the action considered undirected (can gain stealth via
Creepshow)?
6) Cross-table votes can be blocked by the target? (Banishing my
grand-predator's vampire, in a five player game)

Messages.Author: Chris.QJ
Messages.Body:
galama...@hotmail.com (Uriel) schrieb:

hi,

>Here we go:
>1) Can permanents be transferred/stolen by minions who do not meet the
>clan requirement? (e.g. If Anton has the Femur and is diablerized by a
>brujah, can the Brujah take and use the equipment?)

yes. requirements must be met only when bringing the card into play.

>2) Locuipment counts also as equipment while in play?

no. it counts as a location

>3) Can minions attempt action, that cost more blood than they have?

no.

>4) Can a minion use Shadow Strike, if an Immortal Grapple has been
>played.

no. because the strike is ranged (therefore not a hand strike)

>5) If an action is directed at the owner of the minion who attempts
>it,

> a) can both her prey and predator block?

yes as it is an undirected action

> b) is the action considered undirected (can gain stealth via
>Creepshow)?

yes. same reason.

>6) Cross-table votes can be blocked by the target? (Banishing my
>grand-predator's vampire, in a five player game)

no. every political action counts as undirected (no matter whose
pool/location/minions/etc the terms of the referendum targets). eagles
sight and the likes of course allow such blocks.

regards
Chris.QJ

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 13 Nov 2002 15:57:40 -0800, galama...@hotmail.com (Uriel)
wrote:

>May I add two more questions?

Yes.

>1) If a Ravnos plays Illusions of the Kindred can his opponent Psyche!
>or TP Track, before the new vampires enters combat (aka before the
>card resolves)?

No.

Psyche cannot be played before or after an Illusions of the Kindred
induced combat.

LSJ 2001-07-28
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3B62A2B6.27205DD0%40white-wolf.com

LSJ 1997-10-07
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=343A248D.167E%40wizards.com

>2) When a vampire is about to get burned, can his controller chose to
>have him burned without entering torpor?

All of the damage from the same strike resolution phase is resolved at
once. There is no point during the resolution of the damage where you
stop dealing with the damage and move the vampire into torpor.

A vampire that will burn from the results of a strike resolution phase
will not enter torpor.

>eg Vampire A has 2 blood and a Fame, vampire B deals 3 normal damage
>and 2 aggravated. Vampire a ?must? first enter torpor and then burned?
>Or he is immediately burned without entering torpor?

Immediately burned without entering torpor.

Online rulebook, 6.4.6.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
